reply.name: domain
reply.definition: The domain of a function is the set of all possible input values for which the function is defined.

reply.name: range
reply.definition: The range of a function is the set of all possible output values that the function can produce.

reply.name: interval notation
reply.definition: A mathematical convention used to describe a set of numbers by using square brackets to include endpoints and parentheses to exclude them or represent unbounded intervals.
